primary_purpose: Extract engineering lessons from a recent tech failure or outage
required_sections: HOOK: Name the incident and the scale of the impact
WHAT HAPPENED: Factual summary of the outage/breach
ROOT CAUSE: The technical failure (e.g., API misconfiguration, untracked bug)
LESSONS: What the engineering community must learn from this
TAKEAWAY: A warning or best practice reminder
tone_rules: Focus strictly on the engineering breakdown and post-mortem
